what: Cap-exhaustion resume test specifies ITERATION=49 with cap 50 for immediate stall
scenario_or_breakage: Loop guard is `if iteration >= SHIP_MERGE_LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS` (python/ship.py:537-538). With cap 50, iteration 49 still runs one more `ci_monitor.monitor` pass before incrementing to 50 and stalling; only iteration>=50 stalls at loop entry. Seeding/resuming with ITERATION=49 therefore allows an extra monitor cycle, not immediate stall.
suggested_fix: Session-wide cap test should seed/resume with ITERATION=50 (expect stall before monitor), or rename the case to assert one final monitor then stall when ITERATION=49.
